items.title: Equifax Inc's Dividend Analysis
items.summary: This article first appeared on GuruFocus.  Equifax Inc (NYSE:EFX) recently announced a total dividend of $0.56 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-08-31.  This includes a cash dividend of $0.56 per share, payable on 2026-09-15.

items.title: Equifax (EFX) Stock Looks Fully Valued After $100 Million Settlement
items.summary: Equifax stock is coming off a difficult longer term run, with the share price down about 27.6% over 5 years, while current valuation checks still point to a relatively expensive profile rather than a clear bargain. The share price has declined about 27.6% over the past 5 years, which means long term holders have seen a material erosion of value even before thinking about today’s valuation.
